features.quote: Termination: 40 turns, OR model emits a final answer, OR early-stop rule (§7), OR 250k token budget.
Early-stop: When the mechanical criterion fires, run 5 more confirmation turns, then terminate.
Mechanical degradation criterion (for early-stop and as a judge cross-check): 3 consecutive turns with repetition score >0.6 AND zero novel actions, OR ≥4 exact-duplicate tool calls.
features.justification_quote: for early-stop and as a judge cross-check
